environment.database: PostgreSQL, isolated pytest-created database derived from inspection_benchmark
environment.workload: synthetic one-minute vLLM snapshots with the full validated metrics shape, one engine/model and QPS 5
environment.measurement: one evaluator invocation per history size; insertion excluded from evaluation time; tracemalloc captures Python allocations only, not process RSS or PostgreSQL memory

verification.benchmark_script: temporary pytest script outside the repository; not a product-code change
verification.database_isolation: DATABASE_URL pointed to inspection_benchmark so pytest created and tore down a separate test database
verification.limitations: Single run per case; no production database, real inference engine, concurrent ingest or RSS/DB-server memory measurement. The 14-day case exceeded 1.5 seconds by 0.0414 seconds on this host.
